title: Back in Los Angeles: Shelly's Manne-Hole and Redd Foxx's club
summary: After France she worked from Shelly Manne's Manne-Hole as home base, then at Redd Foxx's club. She returned from her third Australian tour in 1965 and learned her mother was sick.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: look it up and put it on the tape. Helen, when you got back to L.A., that's when you played Redd Foxx's club?

L. A. from France.
